name: BACK_AND_FORTH
display:
|- forall R s t.
       (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN t ==> R x x y y) /\
       (forall x y x' y'.
            x IN s /\
            x' IN s /\
            y IN t /\
            y' IN t /\
            ~(x = x') /\
            ~(y = y') /\
            R x x' y y'
            ==> R x' x y' y) /\
       COUNTABLE s /\
       COUNTABLE t /\
       (forall f s' t'.
            FINITE s' /\
            s' SUBSET s /\
            FINITE t' /\
            t' SUBSET t /\
            IMAGE f s' = t' /\
            (forall x y. x IN s' /\ y IN s' ==> (f x = f y <=> x = y)) /\
            (forall x y. x IN s' /\ y IN s' ==> R x y (f x) (f y))
            ==> (forall x.
                     x IN s DIFF s'
                     ==> (exists y.
                              y IN t DIFF t' /\
                              (forall z. z IN s' ==> R x z y (f z)))) /\
                (forall y.
                     y IN t DIFF t'
                     ==> (exists x.
                              x IN s DIFF s' /\
                              (forall z. z IN s' ==> R x z y (f z)))))
       ==> (exists f.
                IMAGE f s = t /\
                (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y) /\
                (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s ==> R x y (f x) (f y)))

name: BACK_AND_FORTH_2
display:
|- forall R s t.
       (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN t ==> R x x y y) /\
       (forall x y x' y'.
            x IN s /\
            x' IN s /\
            y IN t /\
            y' IN t /\
            ~(x = x') /\
            ~(y = y') /\
            R x x' y y'
            ==> R x' x y' y) /\
       COUNTABLE s /\
       COUNTABLE t /\
       (forall f s' t' x.
            FINITE s' /\
            s' SUBSET s /\
            FINITE t' /\
            t' SUBSET t /\
            IMAGE f s' = t' /\
            (forall x y. x IN s' /\ y IN s' ==> (f x = f y <=> x = y)) /\
            (forall x y. x IN s' /\ y IN s' ==> R x y (f x) (f y)) /\
            x IN s DIFF s'
            ==> (exists y.
                     y IN t DIFF t' /\ (forall z. z IN s' ==> R x z y (f z)))) /\
       (forall f t' s' x.
            FINITE t' /\
            t' SUBSET t /\
            FINITE s' /\
            s' SUBSET s /\
            IMAGE f t' = s' /\
            (forall x y. x IN t' /\ y IN t' ==> (f x = f y <=> x = y)) /\
            (forall x y. x IN t' /\ y IN t' ==> R (f x) (f y) x y) /\
            x IN t DIFF t'
            ==> (exists y.
                     y IN s DIFF s' /\ (forall z. z IN t' ==> R y (f z) x z)))
       ==> (exists f.
                IMAGE f s = t /\
                (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y) /\
                (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s ==> R x y (f x) (f y)))

name: BACK_AND_FORTH_ALT
display:
|- forall P s t.
       COUNTABLE s /\
       COUNTABLE t /\
       (forall R.
            FINITE R /\ R SUBSET s CROSS t /\ pairwise P R
            ==> (forall x.
                     x IN s
                     ==> (exists y. y IN t /\ pairwise P ((x,y) INSERT R))) /\
                (forall y.
                     y IN t
                     ==> (exists x. x IN s /\ pairwise P ((x,y) INSERT R))))
       ==> (exists R.
                R SUBSET s CROSS t /\
                pairwise P R /\
                (forall x. x IN s ==> (exists y. y IN t /\ x,y IN R)) /\
                (forall y. y IN t ==> (exists x. x IN s /\ x,y IN R)))

       FINITE s
       ==> (forall n. n <= CARD s ==> (exists t. t SUBSET s /\ t HAS_SIZE n))

display:
|- forall n s u.
       s SUBSET u /\ FINITE s /\ CARD s <= n /\ (FINITE u ==> n <= CARD u)
       ==> (exists t. s SUBSET t /\ t SUBSET u /\ t HAS_SIZE n)

name: CHOOSE_SUBSET_EQ
display:
|- forall n s.
       FINITE s ==> n <= CARD s <=> (exists t. t SUBSET s /\ t HAS_SIZE n)

name: CHOOSE_SUBSET_STRONG

name: CHOOSE_SUBSPACE_OF_SUBSPACE

            (exists f g.

                 (forall y. y IN t ==> g y IN s /\ f (g y) = y) /\

       (forall y. y IN t ==> g y IN s /\ f (g y) = y)
       ==> (exists f' g'.

                (forall y. y IN t' ==> g' y IN s' /\ f' (g' y) = y) /\
                (forall x. x IN s ==> f' x = f x) /\
                (forall y. y IN t ==> g' y = g y))

name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_UNION

                ==> (FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P) (s UNION t))

name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_UNION_EQ

       (forall s t. P s /\ P t ==> (FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P) (s UNION t))

name: FINITE_RECURSION
display:
|- forall f b.
       (forall x y s. ~(x = y) ==> f x (f y s) = f y (f x s))
       ==> ITSET f {} b = b /\
           (forall x s.
                FINITE s
                ==> ITSET f (x INSERT s) b =
                    (if x IN s then ITSET f s b else f x (ITSET f s b)))

name: FINITE_RECURSION_DELETE
display:
|- forall f b.
       (forall x y s. ~(x = y) ==> f x (f y s) = f y (f x s))
       ==> ITSET f {} b = b /\
           (forall x s.
                FINITE s
                ==> ITSET f s b =
                    (if x IN s
                     then f x (ITSET f (s DELETE x) b)
                     else ITSET f (s DELETE x) b))

name: FINITE_SUBSET_UNIONS_CHAIN

       FINITE s /\
       s SUBSET UNIONS f /\
       ~(f = {}) /\
       (forall t u. t IN f /\ u IN f ==> t SUBSET u \/ u SUBSET t)
       ==> (exists t. t IN f /\ s SUBSET t)

name: FINITE_SUBSET_UNIONS_CHAIN_EQ
display:

       ~(f = {}) /\
       (forall t u. t IN f /\ u IN f ==> t SUBSET u \/ u SUBSET t) /\
       FINITE s
       ==> (s SUBSET UNIONS f <=> (exists t. t IN f /\ s SUBSET t))

name: FINITE_SUBSET_UNIONS_DIRECTED_EQ

       ~(f = {}) /\
       (forall t u.
            t IN f /\ u IN f
            ==> (exists v. v IN f /\ t SUBSET v /\ u SUBSET v)) /\
       FINITE s
       ==> (s SUBSET UNIONS f <=> (exists t. t IN f /\ s SUBSET t))

name: FINREC
display:
|- (FINREC f b s a 0 <=> s = {} /\ a = b) /\
   (FINREC f b s a (SUC n) <=>
    (exists x c. x IN s /\ FINREC f b (s DELETE x) c n /\ a = f x c))

name: FINREC_1_LEMMA

       FINREC f b s a (SUC 0) <=> (exists x. s = {x} /\ a = f x b)

name: FINREC_EXISTS_LEMMA

name: FINREC_FUN
display:
|- forall f b.
       (forall x y s. ~(x = y) ==> f x (f y s) = f y (f x s))
       ==> (exists g.
                g {} = b /\
                (forall s x.
                     FINITE s /\ x IN s ==> g s = f x (g (s DELETE x))))

name: FINREC_FUN_LEMMA
display:
|- forall P R.
       (forall s. P s ==> (exists a n. R s a n)) /\
       (forall n1 n2 s a1 a2. R s a1 n1 /\ R s a2 n2 ==> a1 = a2 /\ n1 = n2)
       ==> (exists f. forall s a. P s ==> ((exists n. R s a n) <=> f s = a))

name: FINREC_SUC_LEMMA
display:
|- forall f b.
       (forall x y s. ~(x = y) ==> f x (f y s) = f y (f x s))
       ==> (forall n s z.
                FINREC f b s z (SUC n)
                ==> (forall x.
                         x IN s
                         ==> (exists w.
                                  FINREC f b (s DELETE x) w n /\ z = f x w)))

name: FINREC_UNIQUE_LEMMA
display:
|- forall f b.
       (forall x y s. ~(x = y) ==> f x (f y s) = f y (f x s))
       ==> (forall n1 n2 s a1 a2.
                FINREC f b s a1 n1 /\ FINREC f b s a2 n2
                ==> a1 = a2 /\ n1 = n2)

       ==> (forall s.
                (forall n. (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) (s n))
                ==> (exists t.
                         (forall n. (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) (t n)) /\
                         (forall n. t n SUBSET s n) /\
                         pairwise (\m n. DISJOINT (t m) (t n)) (:num) /\
                         UNIONS {t n | n IN (:num)} =
                         UNIONS {s n | n IN (:num)}))

                (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) s /\ (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) t
                ==> (exists s' t'.
                         (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) s' /\
                         (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) t' /\

display: |- is_realinterval (:real)

name: ITERATE_BIJECTION
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f p s.
                (forall x. x IN s ==> p x IN s) /\
                (forall y. y IN s ==> (existsunique x. x IN s /\ p x = y))
                ==> iterate op s f = iterate op s (f o p))

name: ITERATE_CASES
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall s P f g.
                FINITE s
                ==> iterate op s (\x. if P x then f x else g x) =
                    op (iterate op {x | x IN s /\ P x} f)
                    (iterate op {x | x IN s /\ ~P x} g))

name: ITERATE_CLAUSES
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f. iterate op {} f = neutral op) /\
           (forall f x s.
                FINITE s
                ==> iterate op (x INSERT s) f =
                    (if x IN s
                     then iterate op s f
                     else op (f x) (iterate op s f)))

name: ITERATE_CLAUSES_GEN
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f. iterate op {} f = neutral op) /\
           (forall f x s.
                FINITE (support op f s)
                ==> iterate op (x INSERT s) f =
                    (if x IN s
                     then iterate op s f
                     else op (f x) (iterate op s f)))

name: ITERATE_CLAUSES_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall m.
                iterate op (m..0) f = (if m = 0 then f 0 else neutral op)) /\
           (forall m n.
                iterate op (m..SUC n) f =
                (if m <= SUC n
                 then op (iterate op (m..n) f) (f (SUC n))
                 else iterate op (m..n) f))

name: ITERATE_CLAUSES_NUMSEG_LE
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> iterate op {i | i <= 0} f = f 0 /\
           (forall k.
                iterate op {i | i <= SUC k} f =
                op (iterate op {i | i <= k} f) (f (SUC k)))

name: ITERATE_CLAUSES_NUMSEG_LT
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> iterate op {i | i < 0} f = neutral op /\
           (forall k.
                iterate op {i | i < SUC k} f =
                op (iterate op {i | i < k} f) (f k))

name: ITERATE_CLOSED
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall P.
                P (neutral op) /\ (forall x y. P x /\ P y ==> P (op x y))
                ==> (forall f s.
                         (forall x.
                              x IN s /\ ~(f x = neutral op) ==> P (f x))
                         ==> P (iterate op s f)))

name: ITERATE_CLOSED_NONEMPTY
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall P.
                (forall x y. P x /\ P y ==> P (op x y))
                ==> (forall f s.
                         FINITE s /\
                         ~(s = {}) /\
                         (forall x. x IN s ==> P (f x))
                         ==> P (iterate op s f)))

name: ITERATE_DELETE
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f s a.
                FINITE s /\ a IN s
                ==> op (f a) (iterate op (s DELETE a) f) = iterate op s f)

name: ITERATE_DELTA
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f a s.
                iterate op s (\x. if x = a then f x else neutral op) =
                (if a IN s then f a else neutral op))

name: ITERATE_DIFF
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f s t.
                FINITE s /\ t SUBSET s
                ==> op (iterate op (s DIFF t) f) (iterate op t f) =
                    iterate op s f)

name: ITERATE_DIFF_GEN
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f s t.
                FINITE (support op f s) /\
                support op f t SUBSET support op f s
                ==> op (iterate op (s DIFF t) f) (iterate op t f) =
                    iterate op s f)

name: ITERATE_EQ
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f g s.
                (forall x. x IN s ==> f x = g x)
                ==> iterate op s f = iterate op s g)

name: ITERATE_EQ_GENERAL
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall s t f g h.
                (forall y. y IN t ==> (existsunique x. x IN s /\ h x = y)) /\
                (forall x. x IN s ==> h x IN t /\ g (h x) = f x)
                ==> iterate op s f = iterate op t g)

name: ITERATE_EQ_GENERAL_INVERSES
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall s t f g h k.
                (forall y. y IN t ==> k y IN s /\ h (k y) = y) /\
                (forall x.
                     x IN s ==> h x IN t /\ k (h x) = x /\ g (h x) = f x)
                ==> iterate op s f = iterate op t g)

name: ITERATE_EQ_NEUTRAL
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f s.
                (forall x. x IN s ==> f x = neutral op)
                ==> iterate op s f = neutral op)

name: ITERATE_EXPAND_CASES
display:
|- forall op f s.
       iterate op s f =
       (if FINITE (support op f s)
        then iterate op (support op f s) f
        else neutral op)

name: ITERATE_IMAGE
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f g s.
                (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y)
                ==> iterate op (IMAGE f s) g = iterate op s (g o f))

name: ITERATE_IMAGE_GEN
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f g s.
                FINITE s
                ==> iterate op s g =
                    iterate op (IMAGE f s)
                    (\y. iterate op {x | x IN s /\ f x = y} g))

name: ITERATE_IMAGE_NONZERO
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall g f s.
                FINITE s /\
                (forall x y.
                     x IN s /\ y IN s /\ ~(x = y) /\ f x = f y
                     ==> g (f x) = neutral op)
                ==> iterate op (IMAGE f s) g = iterate op s (g o f))

name: ITERATE_INCL_EXCL
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall s t f.
                FINITE s /\ FINITE t
                ==> op (iterate op s f) (iterate op t f) =
                    op (iterate op (s UNION t) f) (iterate op (s INTER t) f))

name: ITERATE_INJECTION
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f p s.
                FINITE s /\
                (forall x. x IN s ==> p x IN s) /\
                (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ p x = p y ==> x = y)
                ==> iterate op s (f o p) = iterate op s f)

name: ITERATE_ITERATE_PRODUCT
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall s t x.
                FINITE s /\ (forall i. i IN s ==> FINITE (t i))
                ==> iterate op s (\i. iterate op (t i) (x i)) =
                    iterate op {i,j | i IN s /\ j IN t i} (\(i,j). x i j))

name: ITERATE_OP
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f g s.
                FINITE s
                ==> iterate op s (\x. op (f x) (g x)) =
                    op (iterate op s f) (iterate op s g))

name: ITERATE_OP_GEN
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f g s.
                FINITE (support op f s) /\ FINITE (support op g s)
                ==> iterate op s (\x. op (f x) (g x)) =
                    op (iterate op s f) (iterate op s g))

name: ITERATE_PAIR
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f m n.
                iterate op (2 * m..2 * n + 1) f =
                iterate op (m..n) (\i. op (f (2 * i)) (f (2 * i + 1))))

name: ITERATE_REFLECT
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall x m n.
                iterate op (m..n) x =
                (if n < m
                 then neutral op
                 else iterate op (0..n - m) (\i. x (n - i))))

name: ITERATE_RELATED
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall R.
                R (neutral op) (neutral op) /\
                (forall x1 y1 x2 y2.
                     R x1 x2 /\ R y1 y2 ==> R (op x1 y1) (op x2 y2))
                ==> (forall f g s.
                         FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> R (f x) (g x))
                         ==> R (iterate op s f) (iterate op s g)))

name: ITERATE_RELATED_NONEMPTY
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall R.
                (forall x1 y1 x2 y2.
                     R x1 x2 /\ R y1 y2 ==> R (op x1 y1) (op x2 y2))
                ==> (forall f g s.
                         FINITE s /\
                         ~(s = {}) /\
                         (forall x. x IN s ==> R (f x) (g x))
                         ==> R (iterate op s f) (iterate op s g)))

name: ITERATE_RESTRICT_SET
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall P s f.
                iterate op {x | x IN s /\ P x} f =
                iterate op s (\x. if P x then f x else neutral op))

name: ITERATE_SING
display: |- forall op. monoidal op ==> (forall f x. iterate op {x} f = f x)

name: ITERATE_SUPERSET
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f u v.
                u SUBSET v /\
                (forall x. x IN v /\ ~(x IN u) ==> f x = neutral op)
                ==> iterate op v f = iterate op u f)

name: ITERATE_SUPPORT
display: |- forall op f s. iterate op (support op f s) f = iterate op s f

name: ITERATE_SWAP
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f s t.
                FINITE s /\ FINITE t
                ==> iterate op s (\i. iterate op t (f i)) =

name: ITERATE_UNION
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f s t.
                FINITE s /\ FINITE t /\ DISJOINT s t
                ==> iterate op (s UNION t) f =
                    op (iterate op s f) (iterate op t f))

name: ITERATE_UNION_GEN
display:
|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f s t.
                FINITE (support op f s) /\
                FINITE (support op f t) /\
                DISJOINT (support op f s) (support op f t)
                ==> iterate op (s UNION t) f =
                    op (iterate op s f) (iterate op t f))

name: ITERATE_UNION_NONZERO

|- forall op.
       monoidal op
       ==> (forall f s t.
                FINITE s /\
                FINITE t /\
                (forall x. x IN s INTER t ==> f x = neutral op)

name: ITERATE_UNIV
display:

name: ITERATO_CLAUSES
display:
|- forall dom neut op (<<=) f.
       iterato dom neut op (<<=) {} f = neut /\
       (forall i k.
            FINITE {i | i IN k /\ f i IN dom DIFF {neut}} /\
            (forall j. j IN k ==> i <<= j /\ ~(j <<= i))
            ==> iterato dom neut op (<<=) (i INSERT k) f =
                (if f i IN dom ==> f i = neut \/ i IN k
                 then iterato dom neut op (<<=) k f
                 else op (f i) (iterato dom neut op (<<=) k f)))

name: ITERATO_CLAUSES_EXISTS
display:
|- forall dom neut op (<<=) f.
       iterato dom neut op (<<=) {} f = neut /\
       (forall k.
            FINITE {i | i IN k /\ f i IN dom DIFF {neut}} /\
            ~({i | i IN k /\ f i IN dom DIFF {neut}} = {})
            ==> (exists i.
                     i IN k /\
                     f i IN dom DIFF {neut} /\
                     iterato dom neut op (<<=) k f =
                     op (f i) (iterato dom neut op (<<=) (k DELETE i) f)))

name: ITERATO_CLAUSES_GEN
display:
|- forall dom neut op (<<=) f.
       iterato dom neut op (<<=) {} f = neut /\
       (forall i k.
            FINITE {j | j IN k /\ f j IN dom DIFF {neut}} /\
            (forall j. j IN k ==> i = j \/ i <<= j \/ j <<= i) /\
            (forall j. j <<= i /\ j IN k /\ f j IN dom DIFF {neut} ==> j = i)
            ==> iterato dom neut op (<<=) (i INSERT k) f =
                (if f i IN dom ==> f i = neut \/ i IN k
                 then iterato dom neut op (<<=) k f
                 else op (f i) (iterato dom neut op (<<=) k f)))

name: ITERATO_CLAUSES_NUMSEG_LEFT
display:
|- forall dom neut op f m n.
       iterato dom neut op (<=) (m..n) f =
       (if m <= n
        then if f m IN dom ==> f m = neut
             then iterato dom neut op (<=) (m + 1..n) f
             else op (f m) (iterato dom neut op (<=) (m + 1..n) f)
        else neut)

name: ITERATO_CLOSED
display:
|- forall dom neut op (<<=) k f P.
       P neut /\
       (forall x y. P x /\ P y ==> P (op x y)) /\
       (forall i. i IN k /\ f i IN dom /\ ~(f i = neut) ==> P (f i))
       ==> P (iterato dom neut op (<<=) k f)

name: ITERATO_EQ
display:
|- forall dom neut op (<<=) k f g.
       (forall i. i IN k ==> f i = g i)
       ==> iterato dom neut op (<<=) k f = iterato dom neut op (<<=) k g

name: ITERATO_EXPAND_CASES
ITERATO_INDUCT
display:
|- forall dom neut op (<<=) k f P.
       P neut /\
       (forall i x.
            i IN k /\ f i IN dom /\ ~(f i = neut) /\ P x ==> P (op (f i) x))
       ==> P (iterato dom neut op (<<=) k f)

name: ITERATO_ITERATE
display:
|- forall op (<<=).
       monoidal op ==> iterato (:A) (neutral op) op (<<=) = iterate op

name: ITERATO_SUPPORT
display:
|- forall dom neut op (<<=) k f.
       iterato dom neut op (<<=) {i | i IN k /\ f i IN dom DIFF {neut}} f =
       iterato dom neut op (<<=) k f

name: ITSET

|- forall b f s.
       ITSET f s b =
       (@g.
            g {} = b /\
            (forall x s.
                 FINITE s
                 ==> g (x INSERT s) = (if x IN s then g s else f x (g s))))
       s

name: ITSET_EQ

|- forall s f g b.
       FINITE s /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> f x = g x) /\
       (forall x y s. ~(x = y) ==> f x (f y s) = f y (f x s)) /\
       (forall x y s. ~(x = y) ==> g x (g y s) = g y (g x s))
       ==> ITSET f s b = ITSET g s b

name: NADD_MUL_LINV

       ~nadd_eq x (nadd_of_num 0)

name: NADD_MUL_LINV_LEMMA0
display:
|- forall x.
       ~nadd_eq x (nadd_of_num 0)
       ==> (exists A B. forall n. nadd_rinv x n <= A * n + B)

name: NADD_MUL_LINV_LEMMA1
display:
|- forall x n.
       ~(dest_nadd x n = 0)
       ==> dist (dest_nadd x n * nadd_rinv x n,n * n) <= dest_nadd x n

name: NADD_MUL_LINV_LEMMA2
display:
|- forall x.
       ~nadd_eq x (nadd_of_num 0)
       ==> (exists N.
                forall n.
                    N <= n
                    ==> dist (dest_nadd x n * nadd_rinv x n,n * n) <=
                        dest_nadd x n)

name: NADD_MUL_LINV_LEMMA3
display:
|- forall x.
       ~nadd_eq x (nadd_of_num 0)
       ==> (exists N.
                forall m n.
                    N <= n
                    ==> dist
                        (m * dest_nadd x m * dest_nadd x n * nadd_rinv x n,
                         m * dest_nadd x m * n * n) <=
                        m * dest_nadd x m * dest_nadd x n)

name: NADD_MUL_LINV_LEMMA4
display:
|- forall x.
       ~nadd_eq x (nadd_of_num 0)
       ==> (exists N.
                forall m n.
                    N <= m /\ N <= n
                    ==> (dest_nadd x m * dest_nadd x n) *
                        dist (m * nadd_rinv x n,n * nadd_rinv x m) <=
                        (m * n) * dist (m * dest_nadd x n,n * dest_nadd x m) +
                        (dest_nadd x m * dest_nadd x n) * (m + n))

name: NADD_MUL_LINV_LEMMA5
display:
|- forall x.
       ~nadd_eq x (nadd_of_num 0)
       ==> (exists B N.
                forall m n.
                    N <= m /\ N <= n
                    ==> (dest_nadd x m * dest_nadd x n) *
                        dist (m * nadd_rinv x n,n * nadd_rinv x m) <=
                        B * (m * n) * (m + n))

name: NADD_MUL_LINV_LEMMA6
display:
|- forall x.
       ~nadd_eq x (nadd_of_num 0)
       ==> (exists B N.
                forall m n.
                    N <= m /\ N <= n
                    ==> (m * n) * dist (m * nadd_rinv x n,n * nadd_rinv x m) <=

name: NADD_MUL_LINV_LEMMA7
display:
|- forall x.
       ~nadd_eq x (nadd_of_num 0)
       ==> (exists B N.

                    N <= m /\ N <= n
                    ==> dist (m * nadd_rinv x n,n * nadd_rinv x m) <=

name: NADD_MUL_LINV_LEMMA7a
display:

name: NSUM_0

name: NSUM_ADD
display: |- forall f g s. FINITE s ==> nsum s (\x. f x + g x) = nsum s f + nsum s g

name: NSUM_ADD_GEN
NSUM_ADD_NUMSEG

name: NSUM_BIJECTION

       (forall x. x IN s ==> p x IN s) /\
       (forall y. y IN s ==> (existsunique x. x IN s /\ p x = y))
       ==> nsum s f = nsum s (f o p)

name: NSUM_BOUND

name: NSUM_BOUND_GEN

       FINITE s /\ ~(s = {}) /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> f x <= b DIV CARD s)

name: NSUM_BOUND_LT
display:
|- forall s f b.
       FINITE s /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> f x <= b) /\
       (exists x. x IN s /\ f x < b)
       ==> nsum s f < CARD s * b

name: NSUM_BOUND_LT_ALL

name: NSUM_BOUND_LT_GEN
display:

name: NSUM_CASES
display:
|- forall s P f g.
       FINITE s
       ==> nsum s (\x. if P x then f x else g x) =
           nsum {x | x IN s /\ P x} f + nsum {x | x IN s /\ ~P x} g

name: NSUM_CLAUSES
display:
|- (forall f. nsum {} f = 0) /\
   (forall x f s.
        FINITE s
        ==> nsum (x INSERT s) f =
            (if x IN s then nsum s f else f x + nsum s f))

name: NSUM_CLAUSES_LEFT
display: |- forall f m n. m <= n ==> nsum (m..n) f = f m + nsum (m + 1..n) f

name: NSUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG
display:
|- (forall m. nsum (m..0) f = (if m = 0 then f 0 else 0)) /\
   (forall m n.
        nsum (m..SUC n) f =
        (if m <= SUC n then nsum (m..n) f + f (SUC n) else nsum (m..n) f))

name: NSUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG_LE
display:
|- nsum {i | i <= 0} f = f 0 /\
   (forall k. nsum {i | i <= SUC k} f = nsum {i | i <= k} f + f (SUC k))

name: NSUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG_LT
display:
|- nsum {i | i < 0} f = 0 /\
   (forall k. nsum {i | i < SUC k} f = nsum {i | i < k} f + f k)

name: NSUM_CLAUSES_RIGHT
display: |- forall f m n. 0 < n /\ m <= n ==> nsum (m..n) f = nsum (m..n - 1) f + f n

name: NSUM_CLOSED

       P 0 /\
       (forall x y. P x /\ P y ==> P (x + y)) /\
       (forall a. a IN s ==> P (f a))
       ==> P (nsum s f)

name: NSUM_CLOSED_NONEMPTY

       FINITE s /\
       ~(s = {}) /\
       (forall x y. P x /\ P y ==> P (x + y)) /\
       (forall a. a IN s ==> P (f a))
       ==> P (nsum s f)

name: NSUM_CONST_NUMSEG

name: NSUM_DEGENERATE

name: NSUM_DELETE

name: NSUM_DELTA

name: NSUM_DIFF

name: NSUM_EQ

name: NSUM_EQ_0

name: NSUM_EQ_0_IFF

name: NSUM_EQ_0_IFF_NUMSEG

name: NSUM_EQ_0_NUMSEG

name: NSUM_EQ_GENERAL
display:
|- forall s t f g h.
       (forall y. y IN t ==> (existsunique x. x IN s /\ h x = y)) /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> h x IN t /\ g (h x) = f x)
       ==> nsum s f = nsum t g

name: NSUM_EQ_GENERAL_INVERSES

            (forall P. (exists g. P g) <=> (exists g. P (f o g))) /\
            (forall P. (forall g. P g) <=> (forall g. P (f o g))) /\
            (forall P. (exists g. P g) <=> (exists g. P (f o g))) /\
            (forall Q. (forall l. Q l) <=> (forall l. Q (MAP f l))) /\
            (forall Q. (exists l. Q l) <=> (exists l. Q (MAP f l)))) /\
           (forall P. {x | P x} = IMAGE f {x | P (f x)}) /\

name: RELATIVE_TO_SUBSET
display: |- forall P s t. s SUBSET t /\ P s ==> (P relative_to t) s

name: RELATIVE_TO_SUBSET_INC
display: |- forall P u s. s SUBSET u /\ P s ==> (P relative_to u) s

name: RELATIVE_TO_SUBSET_TRANS
display:
|- forall P u s t.
       (P relative_to u) s /\ s SUBSET t /\ t SUBSET u
       ==> (P relative_to t) s

name: RELATIVE_TO_UNION
display:
|- forall P s.
       (forall c d. P c /\ P d ==> P (c UNION d))
       ==> (forall c d.
                (P relative_to s) c /\ (P relative_to s) d
                ==> (P relative_to s) (c UNION d))

name: RELATIVE_TO_UNIV
display: |- forall P s. (P relative_to (:A)) s <=> P s

name: REPLICATE

name: REST

name: RESTRICTION
display: |- forall s f x. RESTRICTION s f x = (if x IN s then f x else ARB)

name: RESTRICTION_COMPOSE
display:
|- forall f g s t.
       IMAGE f s SUBSET t
       ==> RESTRICTION s (RESTRICTION t g o RESTRICTION s f) =
           RESTRICTION s (g o f)

name: RESTRICTION_COMPOSE_LEFT
display:
|- forall f g s t.
       IMAGE f s SUBSET t
       ==> RESTRICTION s (RESTRICTION t g o f) = RESTRICTION s (g o f)

name: RESTRICTION_COMPOSE_RIGHT
display: |- forall f g s. RESTRICTION s (g o RESTRICTION s f) = RESTRICTION s (g o f)

name: RESTRICTION_DEFINED
display: |- forall s f x. x IN s ==> RESTRICTION s f x = f x

name: RESTRICTION_EQ
display: |- forall s f x y. x IN s /\ f x = y ==> RESTRICTION s f x = y

name: RESTRICTION_EXTENSION
display:
|- forall s f g.
       RESTRICTION s f = RESTRICTION s g <=> (forall x. x IN s ==> f x = g x)

name: RESTRICTION_FIXPOINT
display: |- forall s f. RESTRICTION s f = f <=> f IN EXTENSIONAL s

name: RESTRICTION_IDEMP
display: |- forall s f. RESTRICTION s (RESTRICTION s f) = RESTRICTION s f

name: RESTRICTION_IN_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
display:
|- forall k s f.
       RESTRICTION k f IN cartesian_product k s <=>
       (forall i. i IN k ==> f i IN s i)

name: RESTRICTION_IN_EXTENSIONAL
display: |- forall s f. RESTRICTION s f IN EXTENSIONAL s

name: RESTRICTION_RESTRICTION
display:
|- forall s t f.
       s SUBSET t ==> RESTRICTION s (RESTRICTION t f) = RESTRICTION s f

name: RESTRICTION_THM
display: |- forall s f. RESTRICTION s f = (\x. if x IN s then f x else ARB)

name: RESTRICTION_UNDEFINED
display: |- forall s f x. ~(x IN s) ==> RESTRICTION s f x = ARB

name: RESTRICTION_UNIQUE
display:
|- forall s f g.
       RESTRICTION s f = g <=>
       EXTENSIONAL s g /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> f x = g x)

name: RESTRICTION_UNIQUE_ALT
display:

       f = RESTRICTION s g <=>
       EXTENSIONAL s f /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> f x = g x)

name: RESTRICTION_UNIV

name: RIGHT_OR_FORALL_THM

       (forall x y. P x /\ P y /\ f x = f y ==> x = y)

       (forall i r k1 k2 N.

            (forall j. N <= j ==> (exists j'. j <= j' /\ k2 j = k1 j'))
            ==> P i (r o k2))
       ==> (forall r.
                exists k.
                    (forall m n. m < n ==> k m < k n) /\
                    (forall i. P i (r o k)))

name: SUBSET_INTERVAL
display:
|- (interval [c,d] SUBSET interval [a,b] <=>
    (forall i. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex (:N) ==> c$i <= d$i)
    ==> (forall i. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex (:N) ==> a$i <= c$i /\ d$i <= b$i)) /\
   (interval [c,d] SUBSET interval (a,b) <=>
    (forall i. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex (:N) ==> c$i <= d$i)
    ==> (forall i. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex (:N) ==> a$i < c$i /\ d$i < b$i)) /\
   (interval (c,d) SUBSET interval [a,b] <=>
    (forall i. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex (:N) ==> c$i < d$i)
    ==> (forall i. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex (:N) ==> a$i <= c$i /\ d$i <= b$i)) /\
   (interval (c,d) SUBSET interval (a,b) <=>
    (forall i. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex (:N) ==> c$i < d$i)
    ==> (forall i. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex (:N) ==> a$i <= c$i /\ d$i <= b$i))

name: SUBSET_INTERVAL_IMP
display:
|- ((forall i. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex (:N) ==> a$i <= c$i /\ d$i <= b$i)
    ==> interval [c,d] SUBSET interval [a,b]) /\
   ((forall i. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex (:N) ==> a$i < c$i /\ d$i < b$i)
    ==> interval [c,d] SUBSET interval (a,b)) /\
   ((forall i. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex (:N) ==> a$i <= c$i /\ d$i <= b$i)
    ==> interval (c,d) SUBSET interval [a,b]) /\
   ((forall i. 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex (:N) ==> a$i <= c$i /\ d$i <= b$i)
    ==> interval (c,d) SUBSET interval (a,b))

       FINITE s
       ==> sum s (\x. if P x then f x else g x) =
           sum {x | x IN s /\ P x} f + sum {x | x IN s /\ ~P x} g

name: SUM_CASES_1
display:
|- forall s a.
       FINITE s /\ a IN s
       ==> sum s (\x. if x = a then y else f x) = sum s f + y - f a

name: SUM_CLAUSES
display:
|- (forall f. sum {} f = &0) /\
   (forall x f s.
        FINITE s
        ==> sum (x INSERT s) f = (if x IN s then sum s f else f x + sum s f))

name: SUM_CLAUSES_LEFT
display: |- forall f m n. m <= n ==> sum (m..n) f = f m + sum (m + 1..n) f

name: SUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG
display:
|- (forall m. sum (m..0) f = (if m = 0 then f 0 else &0)) /\
   (forall m n.
        sum (m..SUC n) f =
        (if m <= SUC n then sum (m..n) f + f (SUC n) else sum (m..n) f))

name: SUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG_LE
display:
|- sum {i | i <= 0} f = f 0 /\
   (forall k. sum {i | i <= SUC k} f = sum {i | i <= k} f + f (SUC k))

name: SUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG_LT
display:
|- sum {i | i < 0} f = &0 /\
   (forall k. sum {i | i < SUC k} f = sum {i | i < k} f + f k)

name: SUM_CLAUSES_RIGHT
display: |- forall f m n. 0 < n /\ m <= n ==> sum (m..n) f = sum (m..n - 1) f + f n

name: SUM_CLOSED
display:
|- forall P f s.
       P (&0) /\
       (forall x y. P x /\ P y ==> P (x + y)) /\
       (forall a. a IN s ==> P (f a))
       ==> P (sum s f)

name: SUM_CLOSED_NONEMPTY
display:
|- forall P f s.
       FINITE s /\
       ~(s = {}) /\
       (forall x y. P x /\ P y ==> P (x + y)) /\
       (forall a. a IN s ==> P (f a))
       ==> P (sum s f)

name: SUM_COMBINE_L
display:
|- forall f m n p.
       0 < n /\ m <= n /\ n <= p + 1
       ==> sum (m..n - 1) f + sum (n..p) f = sum (m..p) f

name: SUM_COMBINE_R
display:
|- forall f m n p.
       m <= n + 1 /\ n <= p
       ==> sum (m..n) f + sum (n + 1..p) f = sum (m..p) f

name: SUM_CONST
display: |- forall c s. FINITE s ==> sum s (\n. c) = &(CARD s) * c

name: SUM_CONST_NUMSEG
display: |- forall c m n. sum (m..n) (\n. c) = &((n + 1) - m) * c

name: SUM_DEGENERATE
display: |- forall f s. ~FINITE {x | x IN s /\ ~(f x = &0)} ==> sum s f = &0

name: SUM_DELETE
display: |- forall f s a. FINITE s /\ a IN s ==> sum (s DELETE a) f = sum s f - f a

name: SUM_DELETE_CASES
display:
|- forall f s a.
       FINITE s
       ==> sum (s DELETE a) f = (if a IN s then sum s f - f a else sum s f)

name: SUM_DELTA
display:
|- forall s a.
       sum s (\x. if x = a then b else &0) = (if a IN s then b else &0)

name: SUM_DIFF
display:
|- forall f s t.
       FINITE s /\ t SUBSET s ==> sum (s DIFF t) f = sum s f - sum t f

name: SUM_DIFFS
display:
|- forall m n.
       sum (m..n) (\k. f k - f (k + 1)) =
       (if m <= n then f m - f (n + 1) else &0)

name: SUM_DIFFS_ALT
display:
|- forall m n.
       sum (m..n) (\k. f (k + 1) - f k) =
       (if m <= n then f (n + 1) - f m else &0)

name: SUM_EQ
display: |- forall f g s. (forall x. x IN s ==> f x = g x) ==> sum s f = sum s g

name: SUM_EQ_0
display: |- forall f s. (forall x. x IN s ==> f x = &0) ==> sum s f = &0

name: SUM_EQ_0_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f m n.
       (forall i. m <= i /\ i <= n ==> f i = &0) ==> sum (m..n) f = &0

name: SUM_EQ_GENERAL
display:
|- forall s t f g h.
       (forall y. y IN t ==> (existsunique x. x IN s /\ h x = y)) /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> h x IN t /\ g (h x) = f x)
       ==> sum s f = sum t g

name: SUM_EQ_GENERAL_INVERSES
display:
|- forall s t f g h k.
       (forall y. y IN t ==> k y IN s /\ h (k y) = y) /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> h x IN t /\ k (h x) = x /\ g (h x) = f x)
       ==> sum s f = sum t g

name: SUM_EQ_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f g m n.
       (forall i. m <= i /\ i <= n ==> f i = g i)
       ==> sum (m..n) f = sum (m..n) g

name: SUM_EQ_SUPERSET
display:
|- forall f s t.
       FINITE t /\
       t SUBSET s /\
       (forall x. x IN t ==> f x = g x) /\
       (forall x. x IN s /\ ~(x IN t) ==> f x = &0)
       ==> sum s f = sum t g

name: SUM_GP
display:
|- forall x m n.
       sum (m..n) (\i. x pow i) =
       (if n < m
        then &0
        else if x = &1
             then &((n + 1) - m)
             else (x pow m - x pow SUC n) / (&1 - x))

name: SUM_GP_BASIC
display: |- forall x n. (&1 - x) * sum (0..n) (\i. x pow i) = &1 - x pow SUC n

name: SUM_GP_MULTIPLIED
display:
|- forall x m n.
       m <= n ==> (&1 - x) * sum (m..n) (\i. x pow i) = x pow m - x pow SUC n

name: SUM_GP_OFFSET
display:
|- forall x m n.
       sum (m..m + n) (\i. x pow i) =
       (if x = &1 then &n + &1 else x pow m * (&1 - x pow SUC n) / (&1 - x))

name: SUM_GROUP
display:
|- forall f g s t.
       FINITE s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET t
       ==> sum t (\y. sum {x | x IN s /\ f x = y} g) = sum s g

name: SUM_GROUP_RELATION
display:
|- forall R g s t.
       FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> (existsunique y. y IN t /\ R x y))
       ==> sum t (\y. sum {x | x IN s /\ R x y} g) = sum s g

name: SUM_IMAGE
display:
|- forall f g s.
       (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y)
       ==> sum (IMAGE f s) g = sum s (g o f)

name: SUM_IMAGE_GEN
display:
|- forall f g s.
       FINITE s
       ==> sum s g = sum (IMAGE f s) (\y. sum {x | x IN s /\ f x = y} g)

name: SUM_IMAGE_LE
display:
|- forall f g s.
       FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> &0 <= g (f x))
       ==> sum (IMAGE f s) g <= sum s (g o f)

name: SUM_IMAGE_NONZERO
display:
|- forall d i s.
       FINITE s /\
       (forall x y.
            x IN s /\ y IN s /\ ~(x = y) /\ i x = i y ==> d (i x) = &0)
       ==> sum (IMAGE i s) d = sum s (d o i)

name: SUM_INCL_EXCL
display:
|- forall s t f.
       FINITE s /\ FINITE t
       ==> sum s f + sum t f = sum (s UNION t) f + sum (s INTER t) f

name: SUM_INJECTION
display:
|- forall f p s.
       FINITE s /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> p x IN s) /\
       (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ p x = p y ==> x = y)
       ==> sum s (f o p) = sum s f

name: SUM_LE
display:
|- forall f g s.
       FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> f x <= g x) ==> sum s f <= sum s g

name: SUM_LE_INCLUDED
display:
|- forall f g s t i.
       FINITE s /\
       FINITE t /\
       (forall y. y IN t ==> &0 <= g y) /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> (exists y. y IN t /\ i y = x /\ f x <= g y))
       ==> sum s f <= sum t g

name: SUM_LE_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f g m n.
       (forall i. m <= i /\ i <= n ==> f i <= g i)
       ==> sum (m..n) f <= sum (m..n) g

name: SUM_LMUL
display: |- forall f c s. sum s (\x. c * f x) = c * sum s f

name: SUM_LT
display:
|- forall f g s.
       FINITE s /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> f x <= g x) /\
       (exists x. x IN s /\ f x < g x)
       ==> sum s f < sum s g

name: SUM_LT_ALL
display:
|- forall f g s.
       FINITE s /\ ~(s = {}) /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> f x < g x)
       ==> sum s f < sum s g

name: SUM_MULTICOUNT
display:
|- forall R s t k.
       FINITE s /\
       FINITE t /\
       (forall j. j IN t ==> CARD {i | i IN s /\ R i j} = k)
       ==> sum s (\i. &(CARD {j | j IN t /\ R i j})) = &(k * CARD t)

name: SUM_MULTICOUNT_GEN
display:
|- forall R s t k.
       FINITE s /\
       FINITE t /\
       (forall j. j IN t ==> CARD {i | i IN s /\ R i j} = k j)
       ==> sum s (\i. &(CARD {j | j IN t /\ R i j})) = sum t (\i. &(k i))

name: SUM_MUL_BOUND
display:
|- forall a b s.
       FINITE s /\ (forall i. i IN s ==> &0 <= a i /\ &0 <= b i)
       ==> sum s (\i. a i * b i) <= sum s a * sum s b

name: SUM_NEG
display: |- forall f s. sum s (\x. --f x) = --sum s f

name: SUM_OFFSET
display: |- forall p f m n. sum (m + p..n + p) f = sum (m..n) (\i. f (i + p))

name: SUM_OFFSET_0
display: |- forall f m n. m <= n ==> sum (m..n) f = sum (0..n - m) (\i. f (i + m))

name: SUM_PAIR
display:
|- forall f m n.
       sum (2 * m..2 * n + 1) f = sum (m..n) (\i. f (2 * i) + f (2 * i + 1))

name: SUM_PARTIAL_PRE
display:
|- forall f g m n.
       sum (m..n) (\k. f k * (g k - g (k - 1))) =
       (if m <= n
        then f (n + 1) * g n -
             f m * g (m - 1) -
             sum (m..n) (\k. g k * (f (k + 1) - f k))
        else &0)

name: SUM_PARTIAL_SUC
display:
|- forall f g m n.
       sum (m..n) (\k. f k * (g (k + 1) - g k)) =
       (if m <= n
        then f (n + 1) * g (n + 1) -
             f m * g m -
             sum (m..n) (\k. g (k + 1) * (f (k + 1) - f k))
        else &0)

name: SUM_POS_BOUND
display:
|- forall f b s.
       FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> &0 <= f x) /\ sum s f <= b
       ==> (forall x. x IN s ==> f x <= b)

name: SUM_POS_EQ_0
display:
|- forall f s.
       FINITE s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> &0 <= f x) /\ sum s f = &0
       ==> (forall x. x IN s ==> f x = &0)

name: SUM_POS_EQ_0_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall f m n.
       (forall p. m <= p /\ p <= n ==> &0 <= f p) /\ sum (m..n) f = &0
       ==> (forall p. m <= p /\ p <= n ==> f p = &0)

name: SUM_POS_LE
display: |- forall s. (forall x. x IN s ==> &0 <= f x) ==> &0 <= sum s f

name: SUM_POS_LE_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall m n f.
       (forall p. m <= p /\ p <= n ==> &0 <= f p) ==> &0 <= sum (m..n) f

name: SUM_POS_LT
display:
|- forall f s.
       FINITE s /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> &0 <= f x) /\
       (exists x. x IN s /\ &0 < f x)
       ==> &0 < sum s f

name: SUM_POS_LT_ALL
display:
|- forall s f.
       FINITE s /\ ~(s = {}) /\ (forall i. i IN s ==> &0 < f i)
       ==> &0 < sum s f

name: SUM_REFLECT
display:
|- forall x m n.
       sum (m..n) x = (if n < m then &0 else sum (0..n - m) (\i. x (n - i)))

name: SUM_RELATED
display:
|- forall R f g s.
       R (&0) (&0) /\
       (forall m n m' n'. R m n /\ R m' n' ==> R (m + m') (n + n')) /\
       FINITE s /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> R (f x) (g x))
       ==> R (sum s f) (sum s g)

name: SUM_RELATED_NONEMPTY
display:
|- forall R f g s.
       (forall m n m' n'. R m n /\ R m' n' ==> R (m + m') (n + n')) /\
       FINITE s /\
       ~(s = {}) /\
       (forall x. x IN s ==> R (f x) (g x))
       ==> R (sum s f) (sum s g)

name: SUM_RESTRICT
display: |- forall f s. FINITE s ==> sum s (\x. if x IN s then f x else &0) = sum s f

name: SUM_RESTRICT_SET
display:
|- forall P s f.
       sum {x | x IN s /\ P x} f = sum s (\x. if P x then f x else &0)

name: SUM_RMUL
display: |- forall f c s. sum s (\x. f x * c) = sum s f * c

name: SUM_SING
display: |- forall f x. sum {x} f = f x

name: SUM_SING_NUMSEG
display: |- forall f n. sum (n..n) f = f n

name: SUM_SUB
display: |- forall f g s. FINITE s ==> sum s (\x. f x - g x) = sum s f - sum s g

name: SUM_SUBSET
display:
|- forall u v f.
       FINITE u /\
       FINITE v /\
       (forall x. x IN u DIFF v ==> f x <= &0) /\
       (forall x. x IN v DIFF u ==> &0 <= f x)
       ==> sum u f <= sum v f

name: SUM_SUBSET_SIMPLE
display:
|- forall u v f.
       FINITE v /\ u SUBSET v /\ (forall x. x IN v DIFF u ==> &0 <= f x)
       ==> sum u f <= sum v f

name: SUM_SUB_NUMSEG
display: |- forall f g m n. sum (m..n) (\i. f i - g i) = sum (m..n) f - sum (m..n) g

name: SUM_SUM_PRODUCT
display:
|- forall s t x.
       FINITE s /\ (forall i. i IN s ==> FINITE (t i))
       ==> sum s (\i. sum (t i) (x i)) =
           sum {i,j | i IN s /\ j IN t i} (\(i,j). x i j)

name: SUM_SUM_RESTRICT
display:
|- forall R f s t.
       FINITE s /\ FINITE t
       ==> sum s (\x. sum {y | y IN t /\ R x y} (\y. f x y)) =
           sum t (\y. sum {x | x IN s /\ R x y} (\x. f x y))

name: SUM_SUPERSET
display:
|- forall f u v.
       u SUBSET v /\ (forall x. x IN v /\ ~(x IN u) ==> f x = &0)
       ==> sum v f = sum u f

name: SUM_SUPPORT
display: |- forall f s. sum (support (+) f s) f = sum s f

name: SUM_SWAP
display:
|- forall f s t.
       FINITE s /\ FINITE t
       ==> sum s (\i. sum t (f i)) = sum t (\j. sum s (\i. f i j))

name: SUM_SWAP_NUMSEG
display:
|- forall a b c d f.
       sum (a..b) (\i. sum (c..d) (f i)) =
       sum (c..d) (\j. sum (a..b) (\i. f i j))

name: SUM_TRIV_NUMSEG
display: |- forall f m n. n < m ==> sum (m..n) f = &0

name: SUM_UNION
display:
|- forall f s t.
       FINITE s /\ FINITE t /\ DISJOINT s t
       ==> sum (s UNION t) f = sum s f + sum t f

name: SUM_UNIONS_NONZERO
display:
|- forall f s.
       FINITE s /\
       (forall t. t IN s ==> FINITE t) /\
       (forall t1 t2 x.
            t1 IN s /\ t2 IN s /\ ~(t1 = t2) /\ x IN t1 /\ x IN t2
            ==> f x = &0)
       ==> sum (UNIONS s) f = sum s (\t. sum t f)

name: SUM_UNION_EQ
display:
|- forall s t u.
       FINITE u /\ s INTER t = {} /\ s UNION t = u
       ==> sum s f + sum t f = sum u f

name: SUM_UNION_LZERO
display:
|- forall f u v.
       FINITE v /\ (forall x. x IN u /\ ~(x IN v) ==> f x = &0)
       ==> sum (u UNION v) f = sum v f

name: SUM_UNION_NONZERO
display:
|- forall f s t.
       FINITE s /\ FINITE t /\ (forall x. x IN s INTER t ==> f x = &0)
       ==> sum (s UNION t) f = sum s f + sum t f

name: SUM_UNION_RZERO
display:
|- forall f u v.
       FINITE u /\ (forall x. x IN v /\ ~(x IN u) ==> f x = &0)
       ==> sum (u UNION v) f = sum u f

name: SUM_UNIV
display: |- forall f s. support (+) f (:A) SUBSET s ==> sum s f = sum (:A) f

name: SUM_ZERO_EXISTS
display:
|- forall u s.
       FINITE s /\ sum s u = &0
       ==> (forall i. i IN s ==> u i = &0) \/
           (exists j k. j IN s /\ u j < &0 /\ k IN s /\ u k > &0)

name: SUP
display:
|- forall s.
       ~(s = {}) /\ (exists b. forall x. x IN s ==> x <= b)
       ==> (forall x. x IN s ==> x <= sup s) /\
           (forall b. (forall x. x IN s ==> x <= b) ==> sup s <= b)

name: SUPERADMISSIBLE_COND
display:
|- forall (<<) p P s h k.
       admissible (<<) p s P /\
       superadmissible (<<) (\f x. p f x /\ P f x) s h /\
       superadmissible (<<) (\f x. p f x /\ ~P f x) s k
       ==> superadmissible (<<) p s (\f x. if P f x then h f x else k f x)

name: SUPERADMISSIBLE_MATCH_GUARDED_PATTERN
display:
|- forall (<<) p s e pat q arg.
       (forall f a t u.
            p f a /\ pat t = e a /\ q a t /\ pat u = e a /\ q a u
            ==> arg a t = arg a u) /\
       (forall f a t.
            p f a /\ q a t /\ pat t = e a
            ==> (forall y. y << arg a t ==> y << s a))
       ==> superadmissible (<<) p s
           (\f x. match e x with pat t when q x t -> f (arg x t))

name: SUPERADMISSIBLE_MATCH_UNGUARDED_PATTERN
display:
|- forall (<<) p s e pat arg.
       (forall f a t u.
            p f a /\ pat t = e a /\ pat u = e a ==> arg a t = arg a u) /\
       (forall f a t.
            p f a /\ pat t = e a ==> (forall y. y << arg a t ==> y << s a))
       ==> superadmissible (<<) p s
           (\f x. match e x with pat t -> f (arg x t))

name: SUPERADMISSIBLE_TAIL
display:
|- forall (<<) p s t.
       admissible (<<) p s t /\
       (forall f a. p f a ==> (forall y. y << t f a ==> y << s a))
       ==> superadmissible (<<) p s (\f x. f (t f x))

name: SUPPORT_CLAUSES
display:
|- (forall f. support op f {} = {}) /\
   (forall f x s.
        support op f (x INSERT s) =
        (if f x = neutral op then support op f s else x INSERT support op f s)) /\
   (forall f x s. support op f (s DELETE x) = support op f s DELETE x) /\
   (forall f s t.
        support op f (s UNION t) = support op f s UNION support op f t) /\
   (forall f s t.
        support op f (s INTER t) = support op f s INTER support op f t) /\
   (forall f s t.
        support op f (s DIFF t) = support op f s DIFF support op f t) /\
   (forall f g s. support op g (IMAGE f s) = IMAGE f (support op (g o f) s))

name: SUPPORT_DELTA
display:
|- forall op s f a.
       support op (\x. if x = a then f x else neutral op) s =
       (if a IN s then support op f {a} else {})

name: SUPPORT_EMPTY
display:
|- forall op f s.
       (forall x. x IN s ==> f x = neutral op) <=> support op f s = {}

name: SUPPORT_SUBSET
display: |- forall op f s. support op f s SUBSET s

name: SUPPORT_SUPPORT
display: |- forall op f s. support op f (support op f s) = support op f s

name: SUP_APPROACH
display:
|- forall s c.
       ~(s = {}) /\ (exists b. forall x. x IN s ==> x <= b) /\ c < sup s
       ==> (exists x. x IN s /\ c < x)

name: SUP_EQ
display:
|- forall s t.
       (forall b.
            (forall x. x IN s ==> x <= b) <=> (forall x. x IN t ==> x <= b))
       ==> sup s = sup t

name: SUP_EXISTS
display:
|- forall s.
       (exists l. s has_sup l) <=>
       ~(s = {}) /\ (exists b. forall x. x IN s ==> x <= b)

name: SUP_FINITE
display:
|- forall s.
       FINITE s /\ ~(s = {})
       ==> sup s IN s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> x <= sup s)

name: SUP_FINITE_LEMMA
display:
|- forall s.
       FINITE s /\ ~(s = {})
       ==> (exists b. b IN s /\ (forall x. x IN s ==> x <= b))

name: SUP_INSERT_FINITE
display:
|- forall x s.
       FINITE s ==> sup (x INSERT s) = (if s = {} then x else max x (sup s))

name: SUP_INSERT_INSERT
display: |- forall a b s. sup (b INSERT a INSERT s) = sup (max a b INSERT s)

name: SUP_SING
display: |- forall a. sup {a} = a

name: SUP_UNION
display:
|- forall s t.
       ~(s = {}) /\
       ~(t = {}) /\
       (exists b. forall x. x IN s ==> x <= b) /\
       (exists c. forall x. x IN t ==> x <= c)
       ==> sup (s UNION t) = max (sup s) (sup t)

name: SUP_UNIQUE
display:
|- forall s b.
       (forall c. (forall x. x IN s ==> x <= c) <=> b <= c) ==> sup s = b

name: SUP_UNIQUE_FINITE
display:
|- forall s.
       FINITE s /\ ~(s = {})
       ==> (sup s = a <=> a IN s /\ (forall y. y IN s ==> y <= a))

name: SURJ
display:
|- forall t s f.
       SURJ f s t <=>
       (forall x. x IN s ==> f x IN t) /\
       (forall x. x IN t ==> (exists y. y IN s /\ f y = x))

name: SURJECTIVE_EXISTS_THM
display:
|- forall f.
       (forall y. exists x. f x = y) <=>
       (forall P. (exists x. P (f x)) <=> (exists y. P y))

name: SURJECTIVE_FORALL_THM
display:
|- forall f.
       (forall y. exists x. f x = y) <=>
       (forall P. (forall x. P (f x)) <=> (forall y. P y))

name: SURJECTIVE_IFF_INJECTIVE
display:
|- forall s f.
       FINITE s /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET s
       ==> ((forall y. y IN s ==> (exists x. x IN s /\ f x = y)) <=>
            (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y))

name: SURJECTIVE_IFF_INJECTIVE_GEN
display:
|- forall s t f.
       FINITE s /\ FINITE t /\ CARD s = CARD t /\ IMAGE f s SUBSET t
       ==> ((forall y. y IN t ==> (exists x. x IN s /\ f x = y)) <=>
            (forall x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y))

name: SURJECTIVE_IMAGE
display:
|- forall f.
       (forall t. exists s. IMAGE f s = t) <=> (forall y. exists x. f x = y)

name: SURJECTIVE_IMAGE_EQ
display:
|- forall f s t.

name: iterato

|- forall dom neut op (<<=) k f.
       iterato dom neut op (<<=) k f =
       (if FINITE {i | i IN k /\ f i IN dom DIFF {neut}} /\
           ~({i | i IN k /\ f i IN dom DIFF {neut}} = {})
        then let i =
                 (if exists i.
                         i IN k /\
                         f i IN dom DIFF {neut} /\
                         (forall j.
                              j <<= i /\ j IN k /\ f j IN dom DIFF {neut}
                              ==> j = i)
                  then @i.
                           i IN k /\
                           f i IN dom DIFF {neut} /\
                           (forall j.
                                j <<= i /\ j IN k /\ f j IN dom DIFF {neut}
                                ==> j = i)
                  else @i. i IN k /\ f i IN dom DIFF {neut}) in
             op (f i)
             (iterato dom neut op (<<=)
              {j | j IN k DELETE i /\ f j IN dom DIFF {neut}}
             f)
        else neut)

name: real_add_th

|- mk_real ((treal_eq) (x1 treal_add y1)) =
   mk_real ((treal_eq) x1) + mk_real ((treal_eq) y1)

name: real_div
display: |- forall x y. x / y = x * inv y

name: real_ge
display: |- forall y x. x >= y <=> y <= x

name: real_gt
display: |- forall y x. x > y <=> y < x

name: real_interval
display:
|- real_interval (a,b) = {x | a < x /\ x < b} /\
   real_interval [a,b] = {x | a <= x /\ x <= b}

name: real_inv
display: |- inv x = mk_real (\u. exists x. treal_inv x treal_eq u /\ dest_real x x)

name: real_inv_th
display: |- mk_real ((treal_eq) (treal_inv x)) = inv (mk_real ((treal_eq) x))

name: real_le
display:
|- x1 <= y1 <=>
   (@u.
        exists x1 y1.
            (x1 treal_le y1 <=> u) /\ dest_real x1 x1 /\ dest_real y1 y1)

name: real_le_th
display: |- x1 treal_le y1 <=> mk_real ((treal_eq) x1) <= mk_real ((treal_eq) y1)

name: real_lt
display: |- forall y x. x < y <=> ~(y <= x)

name: real_max
display: |- forall n m. max m n = (if m <= n then n else m)

name: real_min
display: |- forall m n. min m n = (if m <= n then m else n)

name: real_mod
display: |- forall x y n. mod n x y <=> (exists q. integer q /\ x - y = q * n)

name: real_mul
display:
|- x1 * y1 =
   mk_real
   (\u.
        exists x1 y1.
            x1 treal_mul y1 treal_eq u /\ dest_real x1 x1 /\ dest_real y1 y1)

name: real_mul_th
display:
|- mk_real ((treal_eq) (x1 treal_mul y1)) =
   mk_real ((treal_eq) x1) * mk_real ((treal_eq) y1)

name: real_neg
display: |- --x1 = mk_real (\u. exists x1. treal_neg x1 treal_eq u /\ dest_real x1 x1)

name: real_neg_th
display: |- mk_real ((treal_eq) (treal_neg x1)) = --mk_real ((treal_eq) x1)

name: real_of_num
display: |- &m = mk_real (\u. treal_of_num m treal_eq u)

name: real_of_num_th
display: |- mk_real ((treal_eq) (treal_of_num m)) = &m

name: real_pow
display: |- x pow 0 = &1 /\ (forall n. x pow SUC n = x * x pow n)

name: real_sgn
display:
|- forall x.
       real_sgn x = (if &0 < x then &1 else if x < &0 then -- &1 else &0)

name: real_sub
display: |- forall x y. x - y = x + --y

name: real_zpow
display:
|- forall z i.
       z zpow i =
       (if &0 <= i then z pow num_of_int i else inv (z pow num_of_int (--i)))

name: row
display: |- forall A i. row i A = (lambda j. A$i$j)

name: rows
display: |- forall A. rows A = {row i A | 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex (:M)}

name: rowvector
display: |- forall v. rowvector v = (lambda i j. v$j)

name: set_of_list
display: |- set_of_list [] = {} /\ set_of_list (CONS h t) = h INSERT set_of_list t

name: sndcart
display: |- forall f. sndcart f = (lambda i. f$(i + dimindex (:M)))

name: span
display:
|- forall (s:real^?239864->bool).
       (span:(real^?239864->bool)->real^?239864->bool) (s:real^?239864->bool) =
       (subspace:(real^?239864->bool)->bool) hull (s:real^?239864->bool)

name: sqrt
display: |- forall x. sqrt x = (@y. real_sgn y = real_sgn x /\ y pow 2 = abs x)

name: strictly
display: |- forall R. strictly R = (\x y. R x y /\ ~R y x)

name: string_INFINITE
display: |- INFINITE (:(char)list)

name: submatroid
display:
|- forall s m.
       submatroid m s =
       matroid (matroid_span m (matroid_set m INTER s),matroid_span m)

name: subspace
display:
|- forall (s:real^?239852->bool).
       (subspace:(real^?239852->bool)->bool) (s:real^?239852->bool) <=>
       (vec:num->real^?239852) 0 IN (s:real^?239852->bool) /\
       (forall (x:real^?239852) (y:real^?239852).
            (x:real^?239852) IN (s:real^?239852->bool) /\
            (y:real^?239852) IN (s:real^?239852->bool)
            ==> (x:real^?239852) + (y:real^?239852) IN (s:real^?239852->bool)) /\
       (forall c (x:real^?239852).
            (x:real^?239852) IN (s:real^?239852->bool)
            ==> c % (x:real^?239852) IN (s:real^?239852->bool))

name: sum
display: |- sum = iterate (+)

name: sum_CASES
display: |- forall x. (exists a. x = INL a) \/ (exists a. x = INR a)

name: sum_DISTINCT
display: |- forall a a'. ~(INL a = INR a')

name: sum_INDUCT
display:
|- forall P.
       (forall a. P (INL a)) /\ (forall a. P (INR a)) ==> (forall x. P x)

name: sum_INJECTIVE
display:
|- (forall a a'. INL a = INL a' <=> a = a') /\
   (forall a a'. INR a = INR a' <=> a = a')

name: sum_RECURSION
display:
|- forall INL' INR'.
       exists fn.
           (forall a. fn (INL a) = INL' a) /\ (forall a. fn (INR a) = INR' a)

name: sup
display:
|- forall s.
       sup s =
       (@a.
            (forall x. x IN s ==> x <= a) /\
            (forall b. (forall x. x IN s ==> x <= b) ==> a <= b))

name: support
display: |- forall s f op. support op f s = {x | x IN s /\ ~(f x = neutral op)}

name: suslin
display:
|- forall (u:(?207722->bool)->bool).
       (suslin:((?207722->bool)->bool)->(?207722->bool)->bool)
       (u:(?207722->bool)->bool) =
       {(suslin_operation:((num)list->?207722->bool)->?207722->bool)
        (f:(num)list->?207722->bool) | forall l.
                                           ~(l = [])
                                           ==> (f:(num)list->?207722->bool) l IN
                                               (u:(?207722->bool)->bool)}

name: suslin_operation
symmetric_matrix
display: |- forall A. symmetric_matrix A <=> transp A = A

name: tailadmissible
display:
|- forall (<<) s p t.
       tailadmissible (<<) p s t <=>
       (exists P G H.
            (forall f a y. P f a /\ y << G f a ==> y << s a) /\
            (forall f g a.
                 (forall z. z << s a ==> f z = g z)
                 ==> (P f a <=> P g a) /\ G f a = G g a /\ H f a = H g a) /\
            (forall f a.
                 p f a ==> t f a = (if P f a then f (G f a) else H f a)))

name: toset
display:
|- forall l.
       toset l <=>
       (forall x. x IN fld l ==> l x x) /\
       (forall x y z. l x y /\ l y z ==> l x z) /\
       (forall x y. l x y /\ l y x ==> x = y) /\
       (forall x y. x IN fld l /\ y IN fld l ==> l x y \/ l y x)

name: transp
display: |- forall A. transp A = (lambda i j. A$j$i)

name: treal_add
display:
|- forall x1 x2 y1 y2.
       (x1,y1) treal_add (x2,y2) = hreal_add x1 x2,hreal_add y1 y2

name: treal_eq
display:
|- forall x1 y2 x2 y1.
       x1,y1 treal_eq x2,y2 <=> hreal_add x1 y2 = hreal_add x2 y1

name: treal_inv
display:
|- forall y x.
       treal_inv (x,y) =
       (if x = y
        then & 0,& 0
        else if hreal_le y x
             then hreal_inv (@d. x = hreal_add y d),& 0
             else & 0,hreal_inv (@d. y = hreal_add x d))

name: treal_le
display:
|- forall x1 y2 x2 y1.
       x1,y1 treal_le x2,y2 <=> hreal_le (hreal_add x1 y2) (hreal_add x2 y1)

name: treal_mul
display:
|- forall x1 y2 y1 x2.
       (x1,y1) treal_mul (x2,y2) =
       hreal_add (hreal_mul x1 x2) (hreal_mul y1 y2),
       hreal_add (hreal_mul x1 y2) (hreal_mul y1 x2)

name: treal_neg
display: |- forall y x. treal_neg (x,y) = y,x

name: treal_of_num
display: |- forall n. treal_of_num n = & n,& 0

name: tybit0_INDUCT
display: |- forall P. (forall a. P (mktybit0 a)) ==> (forall x. P x)

name: tybit0_RECURSION
display: |- forall f. exists fn. forall a. fn (mktybit0 a) = f a

name: tybit1_INDUCT
display: |- forall P. (forall a. P (mktybit1 a)) ==> (forall x. P x)

name: tybit1_RECURSION
display: |- forall f. exists fn. forall a. fn (mktybit1 a) = f a

name: vec
display: |- forall n. vec n = (lambda i. &n)

name: vector
display: |- forall l. vector l = (lambda i. EL (i - 1) l)

name: vector_add
display: |- forall x y. x + y = (lambda i. x$i + y$i)

name: vector_matrix_mul
display: |- forall A x. x ** A = (lambda j. sum (1..dimindex (:M)) (\i. A$i$j * x$i))

name: vector_mul
display: |- forall c x. c % x = (lambda i. c * x$i)

name: vector_neg
display: |- forall x. --x = (lambda i. --(x$i))

name: vector_norm
display:
|- forall (x:real^?212530).
       (norm:real^?212530->real) (x:real^?212530) =
       sqrt ((x:real^?212530) dot (x:real^?212530))

name: vector_sub
display: |- forall x y. x - y = (lambda i. x$i - y$i)

name: vectorize
display:
|- vectorize =
   (\x.
        lambda i.
            x$(1 + (i - 1) DIV dimindex (:N))$(1 + (i - 1) MOD dimindex (:N)))

name: vsum
display: |- forall s f. vsum s f = (lambda i. sum s (\x. f x$i))

name: woset
display:
|- forall l.
       woset l <=>
       (forall x. x IN fld l ==> l x x) /\
       (forall x y z. l x y /\ l y z ==> l x z) /\
       (forall x y. l x y /\ l y x ==> x = y) /\
       (forall x y. x IN fld l /\ y IN fld l ==> l x y \/ l y x) /\
       (forall s.
            s SUBSET fld l /\ ~(s = {})
            ==> (exists x. x IN s /\ (forall y. y IN s ==> l x y)))

name: wqoset
display:
|- forall l.
       wqoset l <=>
       (forall x. x IN fld l ==> l x x) /\
       (forall x y z. l x y /\ l y z ==> l x z) /\
       (forall s.
            s SUBSET fld l
            ==> (exists t.
                     FINITE t /\
                     t SUBSET s /\
                     (forall y. y IN s ==> (exists x. x IN t /\ l x y))))
